reason: S1 changes h2o_socketpool_create_target from two parameters to three parameters, but H0's register_proxy still calls h2o_socketpool_create_target(&upstream, NULL). H0 therefore cannot compile against S1 and cannot reach the socket-pool or proxy behavior it previously exercised. Under S0, the same two-argument call matches the visible declaration, so the gap is introduced by this commit.
evidence: Production call sites in S1 pass three arguments, including h2o_socketpool_create_target(&url, &url, &lb_per_target_conf) and h2o_socketpool_create_target(upstream, upstream, NULL).
recommended_action: Update register_proxy to call h2o_socketpool_create_target with explicit URL and origin arguments, using &upstream for both when no distinct connection target is intended, plus NULL for the target configuration.
